page: Microsoft Azure D48ns_v6 is a general-purpose virtual machine based on the x86_64 architecture, powered by a dedicated 4.2 GHz Intel Xeon 8573C processor. The instance provides 48 vCPUs across 24 physical cores using symmetric multithreading, supported by 260 MB of L3 cache, 2 MB of L2 cache, and 48 KB of L1 data cache. Memory capacity totals 192.0 GB, maintaining a standard 1:4 vCPU-to-memory ratio of 4.0 GB per vCPU. Hardware features include Intel Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX-TILE, AMX-INT8) and AVX-512 vector instruction support. This instance does not include bundled local disk storage or hardware GPUs, relying instead on network-attached Premium Storage capabilities for persistent disk I/O.

Benchmark evaluations show strong execution capabilities across enterprise compute and memory benchmarks. PassMark CPU testing ranks in the top quartile with a score of 61,185.71, aided by strong results in extended instructions (63,333.14) and cryptographic tests (48,159.03). Uncached large-block memory read bandwidth reaches 253.44 GB/sec and write bandwidth achieves 105.32 GB/sec, placing memory throughput in the top 25 percent. The instance also delivers high throughput for data serving, recording 63.28 million operations per second on Redis SET workloads and 80.85 GB/sec on static web serving throughput tests. Multi-threaded bzip3 decompression reaches 291.31 GB/sec. Small-model LLM inference demonstrates top-tier text generation throughput at 336.16 tokens per second, with medium model generation maintaining 30.99 tokens per second.

Without bundled local NVMe storage, disk throughput is bounded by external network storage bandwidth. However, the high core density, substantial cache, and AMX instruction extensions yield efficient CPU-bound execution without requiring dedicated accelerators. The configuration fits high-concurrency web serving, in-memory caching systems, transactional database engines backed by remote managed disks, large-scale compression, and mid-tier CPU-based AI inference pipelines.
description: Microsoft Azure D48ns_v6 is a general-purpose cloud instance configured with 48 dedicated vCPUs and 192.0 GB of memory on an Intel Xeon 8573C processor operating at 4.2 GHz. The x86_64 system provides 24 physical cores with multithreading, 260 MB of L3 cache, and Intel Advanced Matrix Extensions. The VM does not bundle local disk storage or GPUs, utilizing network-attached Premium Storage for persistent volumes. Benchmarks indicate strong multi-core performance, yielding top-quartile results in PassMark CPU tests, uncached memory bandwidth exceeding 253 GB/sec read, and 63.28 million Redis operations per second. While lack of ephemeral local storage shifts all IOPS to remote disks, the high processing density and strong memory throughput deliver solid resource efficiency for memory-backed caches, microservices fleets, relational databases, static web serving, and CPU-driven machine learning inference tasks.
